text: {"headline":"EU refunds jumped from $20 in June to $260 in July 2026, a 13x increase, while order volume held steady at 4 orders per month.","summary":"EU refund amount rose from $20.00 (one size_issue refund) in June 2026 to $260.00 (three shipping_delay refunds) in July 2026, even though total order count stayed flat at 4 in both months. This shows an association between the shift in refund reason mix and the July increase, but with only 4 orders per month and a handful of refunds, the data cannot establish a genuine causal trend versus a data-quality or isolated-incident effect.","contradictions":["Evaluator flagged that the sample is extremely small (4 orders per month, 1 vs 3 refunds), so the month-over-month change is not statistically meaningful, a caveat the SQL Analyst's summary did not include.","Evaluator noted the three July shipping_delay refunds average ~$86.67 each against $300 gross revenue (a 100% refund rate), which may reflect data-quality issues or full-order cancellations rather than a genuine refund trend; the analyst did not flag this possibility.","Evaluator noted it is unverified whether the EU region filter and month attribution use order-date or refund-date, which the analyst's summary presents without qualification."]}
